correctness.rationale: Complete normalization-conductor computation gives the exact unit quotient and dimension. Each binary-form evaluation space has rank d+1 for d<m-1, since a degree-d binary form cannot vanish at m>d distinct directions. The characteristic-p power map selects exponents divisible by p^r; the reduced intersection with ring units has dimension sum(p^r*j+1). The exact exponent is certified by a coordinate-supported unit. The independently programmed modular rank and characteristic-two order-four tests agree across stated ranges; no finite experiment is used as proof of arbitrary m.

value.rationale: The entire p-multiplication image-dimension profile is a natural, isogeny-sensitive group invariant of singular-curve Picard varieties. The result computes it uniformly for an unbounded family of ordinary multiple points, detects a threshold m=p+2 for nonzero multiplication by p, and proves arbitrarily large p-power exponent occurs in a canonical line-pencil geometry. It is not a mere arithmetic genus formula or a single small-field computation.
